about: RHEL-EUS-TARGET-NOTE-1: which machine the targets step marks as made from a RHEL image on the EUS repositories. Microsoft, Red Hat Update Infrastructure (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/virtual-machines/workloads/redhat/redhat-rhui): images connected to EUS repositories contain a minor version number in the SKU; images connected to non-EUS repositories do not (X-LVM, X-RAW); RHUI is for pay-as-you-go images only. The engine (tests/unit/RhelEusTargetNote.Tests.ps1) is held to each expect, and the page (tests/js/rhel-eus-target-note.test.js) to the words. Names are examples only.

cases.name: the lab image, no agent reading
the agent reports the release of the image
the agent reports a later minor release: the machine left the minor release of the image
a minor release Microsoft lists for MANA: its own repositories can hold the kernel
no minor version in the SKU: Microsoft's non-EUS image
Red Hat 8: Microsoft lists no RHEL 8 release for MANA, so no later minor release helps
Azure Hybrid Benefit: a RHEL_BYOS licence type takes its updates from Red Hat, not RHUI
an SAP offer: dedicated RHUI channels, not the EUS rule of the RHEL offer
the agent reports another distribution: the machine was converted
the agent reports another major release: the machine was upgraded in place
